build_MobileV2_MLSD_Large: build a MobileV2_MLSD_Large model instance for straight line detection using MobileNetV2 backbone
run_MobileNetV2_forward: run the MobileNetV2 backbone forward pass to extract FPN features c1 through c5
create_BlockTypeA: create a BlockTypeA module that concatenates two feature maps with optional bilinear upsampling
create_BlockTypeB: create a BlockTypeB module with residual connection and two 3x3 convolutions
create_BlockTypeC: create a BlockTypeC module with dilated convolution, regular convolution, and 1x1 output convolution
